biosecurity_detail.General clean: Prior to a trip vehicles and toolboxes undergo general cleaning.  As standard practice all cars, tools and personal items(ie; boots) should be kept clean and free of organic materials.
biosecurity_detail.Biosecurity declaration: Vehicle and Equipment Washdown by trained individual (Biosecurity) Declaration required.
biosecurity_detail.Washdown and Virkon treatment: Vehicles and toolboxes will undergo a general washdown and cleanliness check prior to visiting the site.  This will Include removing of any organic material (such as grass and seed) from the vehicle cabin. Shoes must also be disinfected using a Virkon wash
